newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK STEEL TO LAUNCH BOND ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK STEEL TO LAUNCH BOND ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Slovak steel maker Zeleziarne Podbrezova a.s. will launch a five-year, 800 million crown bond issue on Thursday, lead manager Slovenska Sporitelna a.s. said.
A senior Sporitelna official told Reuters the bond will carry an annual fixed coupon rate of 12.1 percent.
The issuer has reserved the right to repurchase the issue after three years at the rate of 101 percent, the official said.
The bond, the funds of which will be to restructure the companies' debts, will be traded on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE).
"This is one of several steps towards our financial restrusturing, perhaps the last one this year, but not the final," Marian Kurcik, Zeleziarne finance director told Reuters.
Zeleziarne Podbrezova is Slovakia's major steel pipe producer. It exported two-thirds of its last year's production to western Europe.
VUB, Slovakia's largest commercial bank, is the co-lead manager of the issue.
Three other Slovak banks - Banka Slovakia, Priemyselna Banka and Istrobanka - co-managed the issue.

Sporitelna's treasurer Ivan Benda said Sporitelna had lead managed "five or six" bond issues so far, including one billion crown issue for petrol fules distributor Benzinol a.s. last spring, and 1.5 billion crown issue for energy utility Slovenske Elektrarne a.s. last year.
